evidenceQuotes: Working closely with the Division Head and CYP Leadership Team, the Director of Program Quality and Training of Youth Programs documents best practices, designs tools to measure staff and youth outcomes, and supports collaboration among youth-serving organizations.

This role provides strategic leadership for quality improvement, staff development, and outcomes assessment across Cambridge Youth Programs’ five youth centers serving more than 1,200 youth ages 9–19, partnering with the Division Head and CYP Leadership Team to codify best practices, build measurement tools, and strengthen collaboration among youth-serving organizations.

The Director directly supervises an Administrative Assistant and a Youth Connector, and manages organization-wide partnerships, grant implementation and reporting, and recruitment and outreach efforts.
